execution_log.description: Write stage 5 WS/stream test suite: two-client snapshot parity, pagination, live delta, two-tab growth, scans list, protocol errors, read-only server
execution_log.result: Created 7 node:test cases with in-file spawn helpers (startFixture, startServer, connect, startScanner). Test file written before server/stream implementation landed; ran after.

per_test.name: two clients receive the same snapshot
per_test.checks: both snapshots identical nodes.length > 0 and identical cursor.rev

per_test.name: pagination returns the rest
per_test.checks: page after first-page size with limit 2 returns <= 2 nodes, no id overlap

per_test.name: live delta while scanning
per_test.checks: initial snapshot then non-empty delta or strictly increasing progress.stats.nodes within 30 s

per_test.name: two tabs see the same live growth
per_test.checks: both clients converge on final scan node count within 30 s

per_test.name: scans list endpoint and message
per_test.checks: GET /api/scans items include scan 1; WS scans ids match endpoint

per_test.name: protocol errors
per_test.checks: proto=2 -> error proto or close; open 9999 -> no-scan; unknown t -> error; hello works after

per_test.name: server is read-only
per_test.checks: scan DB size and mtime unchanged after 3 s of client polling

implementation_alignment_notes: Page requests are answered with t='snapshot' per spec §6, not a distinct 'page' frame; test accepts either.
hello proto=1 is acknowledged with {t:'hello',proto:1,ok:true}; test accepts that or {t:'ok'}.
hello proto=2 sends {t:'error',code:'proto'} and then closes; test reconnects before further protocol checks.

workarounds_used: Initial protocol-errors test reused a socket that the server closes after proto=2; test reconnects after asserting the error/close, matching spec allowance.

recommendations: Coverage for search/node/action handlers belongs to stage 7/8; stage 5 correctly returns not-implemented.
